description: This file defines a class implementing a user turn stop strategy based on turn detection analyzers, managing audio frames, VAD events, and transcription to determine when a user has finished speaking.

classes.name: TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Implements a user turn stop strategy using turn detection models, managing frames, VAD events, and transcription to detect end of user turn.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the turn stop strategy with a turn analyzer, timeout, and other parameters.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the strategy to its initial state.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the strategy with a task manager, creating a background task.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up the strategy, cancelling background tasks.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames to update turn analysis and strategy state.

methods.name: _start
methods.description: Configures the turn analyzer at the start of a session.

methods.name: _handle_input_audio
methods.description: Handles raw audio frames, updating turn state and checking for turn completion.

methods.name: _handle_vad_user_started_speaking
methods.description: Handles VAD event indicating user started speaking.

methods.name: _handle_vad_user_stopped_speaking
methods.description: Handles VAD event indicating user stopped speaking, analyzing end of turn.

methods.name: _handle_transcription
methods.description: Handles transcription frames, updating text and resetting timeout.

methods.name: _handle_interim_transcription
methods.description: Handles interim transcription frames, resetting timeout.

methods.name: _handle_prediction_result
methods.description: Handles turn analysis prediction results, pushing metrics frames.

methods.name: _task_handler
methods.description: Background task monitoring events to determine when to trigger user turn stop.

methods.name: _maybe_trigger_user_turn_stopped
methods.description: Triggers user turn stopped event if conditions are met.
